clue.text: Where Cain went off to sleep

definitions.meaning: in Genesis Cain, after killing Abel, went to dwell in a land east of Eden called Nod
the same phrase is a nursery idiom for drifting into slumber

explanation.definitionFit: Biblical place of exile for the first murderer, and a playful idiom for the realm of slumber.

clue.text: Overclothes for one in the fast lane

definitions.meaning: garments worn over the rest, read as the outermost layer of attire

definitions.text: for one in the fast lane
definitions.meaning: a motorist racing along uses the highest ratio of the gearbox

explanation.definitionFit: Outer garments are clothing on top; a speeding driver selects the highest gearbox ratio.

clue.text: A garden in Avon

definitions.meaning: the biblical paradise where Adam and Eve lived
Anthony, Prime Minister in the 1950s, was made Earl of Avon, so he is found in that title

explanation.surface: A garden somewhere in the Avon area.
explanation.walkthrough: Avon is a former English county and river, but here it is the earldom given to the Prime Minister Sir Anthony Eden; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The paradise of Genesis, and the surname of the statesman who became Earl of Avon.

clue.text: Attack Jonathon's father in a way

indicators.note: the father is placed within the abbreviation for a way, so 'in' signals containment

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
in the Bible Jonathan was the son of King Saul

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a biblical prince's father on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue spells Jonathan as 'Jonathon'; the son of King Saul is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent onslaught on a person or position is an attack.

clue.text: Calls for us to amend our wicked ways?

definitions.meaning: pays a casual visit, as a friend does

definitions.text: for us to amend our wicked ways?
definitions.meaning: read as '...', what a reformed sinner must do

explanation.surface: A preacher urging the flock to reform.
explanation.definitionFit: Visits informally is to call by; split differently it means abandon wrongdoing.

clue.text: Setting wage over a pound makes sense

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece set over another comes first

parts.note: a fee is a payment for work, a wage
L is the abbreviation for pound, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: Raising pay above a pound is the sensible thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' puts the payment above the pound sign, so FEE comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To touch or perceive is one of the senses, and as a verb it means sense.

clue.text: Oar I can reshape into a childish little instrument

indicators.note: to reshape the three words is to rearrange their letters into a new form

explanation.surface: Rowing gear remade into a toy flute.
explanation.definitionFit: A small egg-shaped wind toy, often called a sweet potato, played by children.

clue.text: Surprisingly its citizens regard it as their fatherland

definitions.text: Surprisingly its citizens regard it as their fatherland

parts.words: Surprisingly its citizens regard it as their fatherland
parts.note: the paradox is that a fatherland is also referred to by a maternal term for one's native land

explanation.definitionFit: A native land or homeland is called by both a paternal and a maternal name.

clue.text: Support the giving of aid to procure more food

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it
helping is giving assistance

explanation.surface: Backing a charity's relief work to obtain extra rations.
explanation.definitionFit: A further portion at a meal is extra food.

clue.text: After work journalists take down the spirits

indicators.note: the newspaper people come after the opus, so 'After' orders the two pieces

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
the press is the collective term for journalists

explanation.surface: Once the job is done, reporters remove the drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirits' suggests drink, but here it means morale.
explanation.definitionFit: To weigh heavily on someone's mood is to depress or burden them.

clue.text: Conduct a musical work of note

parts.note: an opera is a staged musical work
TE is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Lead an orchestra through a noteworthy piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conduct' suggests an orchestra; here it means run or manage.
explanation.definitionFit: To run or manage a business or machine is to conduct it.

clue.text: Have an inclination to be a cad

definitions.meaning: a ship leans to one side, tilting

explanation.definitionFit: A vessel tilts or lists; a scoundrel is also dismissed by this word.

clue.text: Prue's exchanged the money

indicators.note: the letters of the name and its s swap places, as goods are exchanged

explanation.surface: Prue has swapped the cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum of money, as in prize money or the public finances, is a purse.

clue.text: Did love drive her to death?

definitions.text: Did love drive her to death?

parts.note: taken as written
O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: Was it love that drove a woman to her end?
explanation.walkthrough: The Queen of Carthage burned herself on a pyre when Aeneas left her, so the whole clue also describes her.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary Carthaginian queen killed herself for love of the departing Aeneas.

clue.text: A mathematical scale is lower

parts.note: a base, such as ten or two, is the scale on which a number system counts

explanation.surface: A maths scale is lower than expected.
explanation.definitionFit: To humble or degrade someone is to bring them down, to lower them.

clue.text: A profit is made once more

parts.note: a gain is a profit

explanation.surface: Another profit is made.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeated, another time: a direct synonym.

clue.text: Lightly cooked piece of food

parts.note: rare meat is lightly cooked
a bit is a piece

explanation.surface: A rare scrap of something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: Welsh rarebit is cheese on toast, a British savoury.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheese melted on toast, a dish, so a kind of food.

clue.text: Knocking back gin has a drawback-it makes one tight

indicators.note: knocking back a drink, read as turning each word back to front

parts.note: taken as written
a drag is a nuisance or drawback

explanation.surface: Downing gin has a downside: it gets you drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Knocking back' turns both pieces in place: GIN becomes NIG, DRAG becomes GARD. 'tight' looks like drunk but means mean.
explanation.definitionFit: A miser is tight-fisted, a mean person.

clue.text: Manage to write poetry in Old English

indicators.note: the poetry is placed within the abbreviation, so 'in' signals containment

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Contrive to compose poems in the ancient tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: To supervise or direct work is to manage it.

clue.text: Understanding is shown in an intelligent enterprise

indicators.note: the answer is displayed inside the two words that follow

explanation.surface: Comprehension is demonstrated in a smart venture.
explanation.definitionFit: A friendly agreement between nations, like the Entente Cordiale, is an understanding.

clue.text: The cost of settling ten writers in the East End initially

indicators.note: the ten writers are settled within the two E's, so 'in' signals containment
only the first letter of End is wanted

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten
pens are writing implements

explanation.surface: What it costs to house ten authors in London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes the first letter of End only; 'East End' looks like the London district.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay of money is a cost.

clue.text: Cooked pie given to French priest of refined taste

indicators.note: the pie is cooked into a new arrangement of its letters

parts.note: a curé is a French parish priest

explanation.surface: A gourmet French cleric is served a baked pie.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourmet, someone with discerning palate, is described by this phrase.

clue.text: Eric gives accommodation to a traitor, but it's quite irregular

indicators.note: Eric houses the traitor, so the second piece goes inside the name

parts.note: taken as written
a rat is a traitor

explanation.surface: Eric puts up a turncoat, which is most unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpredictable and inconsistent behaviour is irregular.

clue.text: Try to cut down, but in vain

definitions.meaning: split in two, the answer is an instruction to consume less

explanation.surface: Dieting attempts that come to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Futile or pointless, and split as advice to economise on consumption.

clue.text: Teaching union's crazy

parts.note: NUT is the National Union of Teachers
the possessive ending supplies its letter

explanation.walkthrough: The NUT was Britain's National Union of Teachers.
explanation.definitionFit: Mad or barmy: informal slang for insane.

clue.text: Save a tyre for emergency

definitions.meaning: the extra wheel carried in the boot

explanation.surface: Keeping an extra wheel in case of a puncture.
explanation.definitionFit: To show mercy or refrain from harming; also the reserve wheel a car carries.

clue.text: Look this way and that

indicators.note: read in either direction the letters are the same

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Glance this way and that.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick glance is a look.

clue.text: Company doctor in Northern Italy

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A firm's physician posted to northern Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: A lake and town found in Lombardy.

clue.text: Couple of fruit, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the fruit's name is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Two pieces of fruit, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things together form a couple.

clue.text: Feeling under the weather-that's the long and short of it

definitions.text: the long and short of it
definitions.meaning: a summary of the main points

explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted and unwell; also a brief summary of the facts.

clue.text: What the second-hand car dealer is trained to arrange

indicators.note: the letters of the word before are to be arranged anew

explanation.surface: A used-car salesman is taught how to do deals.
explanation.walkthrough: A used car handed over in part-payment for another is what the dealer takes.
explanation.definitionFit: An old vehicle offered in part exchange is what a car salesman accepts.

clue.text: Be fired from work as the result of a new deal

definitions.meaning: to be sacked, given back one's employment papers

definitions.text: as the result of a new deal
definitions.meaning: a card player is dealt a fresh hand

explanation.definitionFit: To be dismissed from employment; literally to be dealt playing cards.
